for name,Qx in [('demo',Q),('test',Qt)]:
    n=np.size(Qx)-1
    for f,label in [(lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j+1] for i in range(15) for j in range(15)),'diag+1'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j-1] for i in range(15) for j in range(1,16)),'antidiag+1'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i,j+1] for i in range(16) for j in range(15)),'horiz'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j] for i in range(15) for j in range(16)),'vert')]:
        print(name,label,f(),'/',n)
    # same but split by parity of i+j
    for f,label in [(lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j+1] for i in range(15) for j in range(15) if (i+j)%2==0),'diag+1 even'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j+1] for i in range(15) for j in range(15) if (i+j)%2==1),'diag+1 odd'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j-1] for i in range(15) for j in range(1,16) if (i+j)%2==0),'anti even'),
                    (lambda:sum(Qx[i,j]==Qx[i+1,j-1] for i in range(15) for j in range(1,16) if (i+j)%2==1),'anti odd')]:
        print(name,label,f())
